automated.summary: Warehouse schema + write path + gold view, after the three-lens review fix loop (all 5 blocking + 1 non-blocking resolved). Hermetic test (warehouse-schema.test.ts, no DB) asserts the schema/repository/migration/guard shape. The DB-backed D-0008 proof lives IN the same file gated by WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST=1 (skips under plain test:hermetic; runs the real migrate + IngestionRepository.replaceActualsBatch atomic-flip proof when the env + WAREHOUSE_PG_* are set), registered in ONE suite (test:hermetic) so quality-gate's one-suite invariant holds. Config guard is now async DNS-resolution based: resolveHost() looks up both the warehouse host and the app pg host and rejects when their resolved IP sets intersect at the same port (normalizing ::ffff:/IPv6/loopback), closing DNS-alias and IPv6-mapped bypasses string matching missed. DB triggers enforce sap_transaction.month = ingest_batch.period and mis_budget.period = batch period (no cross-period double-count). Whole-file inserts chunk at 1000/insert inside the atomic transaction. DEMONSTRATED host evidence (D-0008) against docker warehouse-db (127.0.0.1:5433): npm warehouse:proof exit 0 (repository-exercised 110.25 then 999.00 replacement, rolled back, no leftover state); the gated test passes host-side with WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST=1. Negative control: warehouse:migrate with an app-endpoint alias is rejected. verify.py green; quality-gate 2/0.
